text: Tenancy Notice: Tenant is hereby directed to vacate the premises within 7 days of this notice or the entire security deposit of Rs 1,00,000 shall stand forfeited.
Lease Clause 18: The landlord and maintenance staff may enter and inspect premises at any hour without prior written notice or telephone intimation.
Standard Residential Rental Agreement: Term of 11 months, monthly rent Rs 25,000. Either party may terminate with 30 days prior written notice. Deposit refundable upon vacation.
Eviction Demand: Failure to pay rent penalty of Rs 5,000 per day within 24 hours shall result in immediate lock-out and possession forfeiture.
Commercial Lease: Security deposit is non-refundable under all circumstances and constitutes liquidated damages upon any early surrender.
Notice of Cure: Tenant is informed that maintenance dues for September (Rs 2,500) are pending. Please clear before 15-Nov-2026 to avoid late fee.
Tenancy Renewal Addendum: Rent increased by 5% annually as per agreed terms. Security deposit balance rolled over.
Agreement clause 22: Tenant waives all rights to statutory legal notice under Section 106 of Transfer of Property Act.
Official Society Notice: Water tank cleaning scheduled on Sunday from 9 AM to 1 PM. Regular supply will resume by 2 PM.
Unilateral Vacation Notice: Vacate within 7 days or electricity and water connection will be disconnected without court order.
